layer1_identification.broadClassification: food prop / stylized low-poly game asset
layer1_identification.note: First bread in this batch with true directional asymmetry (elongated shape + a single lengthwise slash) - unlike campagne/wholewheat/pancake which are radially symmetric families.

layer2_form_silhouette.boundingVolume: elongated stretched dome, rounded at both ends, elliptical footprint - closer to campagne's height profile than expected, just stretched along one horizontal axis
layer2_form_silhouette.symmetry: bilateral about the long axis (approximately radial-family construction stretched, not a true capsule with a flat-walled middle)
layer2_form_silhouette.shapeLanguage: organic elongated dome expressed with geometric faceting

measurements_px.slash_span_fraction_of_length: ~0.57 of total length, centered, ~19% margin at each end (does not reach the tips)

macro: elongated dome body (single continuous loaf, no ring-groove system unlike campagne/wholewheat)
meso: single lengthwise slash valley, centered, margin at both ends
micro: dense caraway seed scatter across the whole surface
hard-edged mottled dark/light patches across the crust

layer4_spatial: <slash, embedded-in, dome body> contact: one linear trench running along the top of the loaf lengthwise, centered, stopping short of both tips, exposing a lighter golden interior at the floor
<caraway seeds, scattered-on, dome surface> contact: dense small raised fleck scatter across the whole crust, avoiding only the slash floor itself
<mottled patches, blended-into, dome surface> contact: broad hard-edged dark patches over a lighter chestnut base, not a smooth gradient
no floating parts; single continuous body resting on a flat unseen base

layer5_materials.single_substance: opaque dielectric, matte crust (mottled) + a second opaque dielectric, matte, shared by the slash-floor crumb and the caraway seeds (both read as a similarly bright warm tone against the dark mottled crust)
layer5_materials.roughness: 1.0 (fully matte clay); no specular lobe anywhere
layer5_materials.relief: faceted planar shading; slash reads as a shallow, fairly wide-floored valley (weaker/shallower than campagne's V-notch), seeds read as small raised faceted flecks
layer5_materials.runtimeNote: consumer runtime force-replaces every material with MeshLambertMaterial keeping only map+color (scripts/breads/types.ts section 2)

layer6_color.crustBase: not specified in JSON hex ('deep chestnut brown' description only) - resolved as a documented deterministic lighten of #4A3226 (see author_spec.py)
layer6_color.seedsAndCrumb: not specified in JSON hex - resolved by reusing the family's existing 'golden' hex #D9A552 (assets/prompts/breads/cracker.json and flatbread.json), shared by both the slash crumb and the caraway seeds per a single bright material (types.ts section 1's <=2 materials constraint)

layer7_identity_features: deep chestnut-to-near-black mottled, blotchy crust (not uniform) - #4A3226 patches over a lighter chestnut base
dense caraway seed topping across the whole surface
single shallow lengthwise slash with only a faintly opened ear - weaker than campagne's, per assets/prompts/breads/rye.json notes_ko
oval bâtard silhouette, elongated but rounder/shorter than a baguette (length/width 1.74, much less extreme than baguette.json's 'extreme length-to-diameter ratio')
layer8_uncertainty: underside is never visible in any of the three views - modelled as a flat closed base
exact seed positions and exact mottle patch shapes are not identity-critical; density/coverage and hard-edged patchiness are what is matched

crust base and seed/crumb hexes have no source in the prompt JSON; resolved by a documented deterministic lighten and a documented reuse of an existing family hex respectively, never pixel-sampled (types.ts section 8)

seeds are rendered as micro-geometry with individual faceting in the reference; this build represents them as a baked texture scatter instead (documented decision, verified against the render before finalizing - see task report)
